主要内容: The Estée Lauder Companies Inc. announced on February 26, 2020, that its Audit Committee approved the dismissal of KPMG LLP as its independent registered public accounting firm. The change followed a competitive process for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2021. KPMG’s audit reports for fiscal years 2019 and 2018 did not contain adverse opinions. The dismissal will take effect after KPMG completes its audits for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2020. The company appointed PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP as its new auditor on February 21, 2020, contingent on completing client acceptance procedures. KPMG provided a letter confirming its agreement with the disclosures, filed as Exhibit 16.1 to the Form 8-K. The CFO, Tracey T. Travis, signed the report on February 26, 2020.
